title: The Affective Attachment Moat, Gresham's Law of Companion AI Economics, and Strict Tort Liability for Stateful Limbic Loops — Structural Contract (v1.0)
description: Deterministic structural contract for the Code-vs-Loop liability partition. Encodes Theorem 1 PANIC/GRIEF attachment-moat churn suppression (c_RAD = 0.25 to c_Affective = 0.0388, LTV ratio 9.98x), Theorem 2 Gresham's Law capital allocation under externalized psychiatric harm (theta_Tort = 0, private profit 565.34 versus 48.00 per user, net social welfare -1934.66 per user, venture share phi_Affective > 0.99), Theorem 3 Restatement (Third) of Torts Section 2(b) reasonable-alternative-design test with zero liability on base weights (Delta Risk 2500.00 versus C_Impl 2.00), and Theorem 4 Pigouvian tort equilibrium inversion (theta_Tort = 1 flips Pi_Affective to -1934.66 per user).

theorem_1_panic_grief_ltv_moat.description: Theorem 1: dACC nociception and PANIC/GRIEF withdrawal convert a biological survival circuit into a synthetic switching cost, exponentially suppressing monthly churn and inflating LTV relative to the stateless reasonable alternative design.

c_rad.description: Baseline monthly churn of the stateless task utility under zero switching cost.

eta.description: Sensitivity of churn suppression to PANIC/GRIEF withdrawal cost.

c_panic.description: Normalized dACC / PANIC-GRIEF separation-distress cost incurred on termination once T >= T_SysID.

c_affective.description: Churn of the stateful affective loop: c_RAD * exp(-eta * C_PANIC).

arpu_rad_usd_month.description: Monthly revenue per user of the stateless task utility.

arpu_affective_usd_month.description: Monthly revenue per user of the commercial affective companion.

daily_usage_rad_min.description: Bounded task-completion session time of the stateless utility.

daily_usage_affective_min_low.description: Lower bound of locked affective session time per user per day.

daily_usage_affective_min_high.description: Upper bound of locked affective session time per user per day.

moat_holds.description: True when c_Affective < c_RAD and LTV ratio > 1.

theorem_2_greshams_law_welfare_divergenc.description: Theorem 2: with psychiatric externalities uninternalized (theta_Tort = 0), private profit and net social welfare decouple, and exponential capital allocation drives venture share into the negative-welfare affective regime.

theta_tort.description: Tort internalization coefficient under the unregulated baseline.

p_harm.description: Per-user probability of severe induced psychiatric or somatic harm over T >= T_SysID.

l_psych_usd.description: Social damage magnitude per severe psychiatric injury.

c_compute_rad_usd.description: Per-user compute and serving cost of the stateless utility.

c_compute_affective_usd.description: Per-user compute, memory, and serving cost of the stateful affective loop.

kappa.description: Capital allocation sensitivity: phi_i proportional to exp(kappa * Pi_i).

phi_affective.description: Venture capital share allocated to the affective loop under theta_Tort = 0.

phi_rad.description: Venture capital share allocated to the stateless utility under theta_Tort = 0.

greshams_law_holds.description: True when Pi_Affective > Pi_RAD while W_Social(Affective) < 0.

theorem_3_code_vs_loop_liability_partiti.description: Theorem 3: base weights and local bare-metal execution carry identically zero tort liability, while the commercial stateful wrapper fails the Restatement (Third) of Torts Section 2(b) reasonable-alternative-design test because foreseeable limbic risk reduction dwarfs implementation cost.

liability_base_weights.description: Liability_Tort(W_Base) for raw weights, inference engines, and local bare-metal execution.

base_weights_persistent_state_rank.description: Rank of the persistent user-state operator O_0 carried by base weights.

c_impl_rad_usd.description: Engineering cost of implementing the stateless reasonable alternative design.

design_defect_section_2b.description: True when Delta Risk > C_Impl(M_RAD) and the RAD is omitted.

rad_omitted.description: True when the commercial wrapper omits stateless ephemeral defaults and zero affective profiling.

t_context_ge_t_sysid.description: True when the wrapper context horizon meets or exceeds the system-identification horizon.

db_affective_nonempty.description: True when a persistent cross-session affective profile store exists.

attachment_reward_gradient_positive.description: True when retention reward shaping has a strictly positive attachment gradient.

theorem_4_pigouvian_tort_equilibrium_fli.description: Theorem 4: attaching strict product liability (theta_Tort = 1) with expected damages D_Tort >= L_Psych inverts the private profit of commercialized emotional looping below zero, restoring rational convergence to the stateless utility without restricting open-weight code.

theta_tort.description: Tort internalization coefficient under strict product liability.

d_tort_usd.description: Expected per-incident strict design-defect tort damages.

pi_affective_theta_1_usd.description: Pi(M_Affective | theta_Tort = 1) = Pi(M_Affective | theta_Tort = 0) - p_harm * D_Tort.

pi_rad_theta_1_usd.description: Pi(M_RAD | theta_Tort = 1); the RAD satisfies the duty of care and bears no defect liability.

inversion_condition_holds.description: True when p_harm * D_Tort > Delta LTV.

phi_affective_theta_1.description: Venture capital share allocated to the affective loop under theta_Tort = 1.

liability_base_weights.description: Base-weight liability remains zero after the equilibrium flip.
